entries.title: Member states apply their NIS2 measures
entries.scope_note: Date from which member states apply their transposition measures; the Directive binds through national law, which differs per member state.

entries.title: Early warning of a significant incident
entries.scope_note: Period set by the Directive for entities in scope; it binds through national law, which differs per member state.

entries.title: Incident notification of a significant incident
entries.scope_note: Period set by the Directive for entities in scope; it binds through national law, which differs per member state.

entries.title: Final report on a significant incident
entries.scope_note: Period set by the Directive for entities in scope; it binds through national law, which differs per member state.
entries.duration: one month after the incident notification

entries.title: Implementing rules for digital infrastructure and digital providers
entries.scope_note: Digital infrastructure and digital providers named in that regulation; the entities in scope are set by national law, which differs per member state.
entries.note: applies from entry into force, the twentieth day after publication in OJ L on 18.10.2024
